**Italy: scale and change.** Across 2000–2025, the extract records 1,305,662 applications. The largest annual volume was 158,588 in 2024; 2025 recorded 133,736. Applications in 2025 were 284% higher than in 2019 (34,869). In 2025, 105,168 recorded decisions equated to 79 per 100 applications, so recorded output fell below incoming volume. Applications in 2025 were 16% lower than in 2024 (158,588). Applications exceeded recorded decisions in 5 of 5 comparable years during 2021-2025. The leading recorded origins that year were Bangladesh (28,039), Peru (15,455), Egypt (11,643).

In 2025, the substantive protection rate was 17%, across 104,547 grants and refusals; closures accounted for 0.6% of all recorded decisions. That protection rate was 4.7 percentage points lower than in 2024 (21%).
